intro: What customers report about our garments: triaged by quality, a safety complaint alerts the owner at once and goes to the PPE register.

noAccess.title: Not for your role
noAccess.body: You need quality.complaints.view to see customer complaints. The owner or an administrator grants it in Admin › Roles & permissions.

offline.title: Offline – the page shows its last copy
offline.body: Changes are held until the connection is back: nothing is sent while offline.

categoryHint.SAFETY: The garment may not protect: alerts the owner and quality, goes to the PPE register.
categoryHint.FUNCTION: Something does not work: a zip, a closure, a seam.
categoryHint.COSMETIC: How it looks: colour, marks, finish.
categoryHint.FIT: Size or shape: it does not fit as expected.

garment.unknownSerial: No garment of ours carries this serial: the facts are as reported.
garment.otherCustomer: This garment was made for another customer's order: check the label.

safetyState.RAISED: Safety alert raised: the owner has not acknowledged it yet. It stays on the Complaints page until then.

banner.title: Safety complaint {number}: {summary} ({garment}). The owner has not acknowledged it yet.
banner.body: Raised {time}. It stays here until the owner acknowledges it.

ack.title: Acknowledge safety complaint {number}
ack.body: You acknowledge, as the owner, that you know about this safety complaint (Reg. (EU) 2016/425 art. 8(4)). The alert leaves the banner; the PPE register entry and its duties stay open.
ack.noteHint: For example: by phone with quality at 10:15.

keys.title: Keyboard shortcuts
keys.saveNext: Save the triage and go to the next

tileHint.dueSoon: Waiting for the answer, due within 3 days or overdue
tileHint.answeredMonth: Answered since the 1st of this month

col.capaHint: The corrective action (CAPA) it is escalated to.
col.valueHint: The order's net value, before VAT.
col.valueNoGrain: Your role does not see prices: the order's value shows as —.

list.search: Search number, customer, reference, serial or batch
list.linked: Of one customer, order, shipment or return
list.exportNothing: Nothing to export in this view
list.failed: The complaints could not be read
list.emptyBody: Log one when a customer reports a problem by phone, e-mail, with a return or in person.

triage.title: Triage {number}
triage.notFound: This complaint is not there any more, or it belongs to another company.
triage.first: This is the first complaint of the queue
triage.last: This is the last complaint of the queue
triage.safetyRaised: This complaint's safety alert is raised and not yet acknowledged by the owner.
triage.safetyAcknowledged: This complaint's safety alert was acknowledged by the owner.
triage.safetyKept: Its safety alert stays on the record even with another category.
triage.safetyWill: Safety: saving tells the owner and quality now and opens its PPE register entry. You confirm first.
triage.ownerHint: The person who follows it up and answers the customer.
triage.answerDueHint: Suggested: {day} (10 working days after it came in).
triage.styleNoList: Your role cannot list styles: the complaint keeps the style it names.
triage.styleHint: A safety complaint needs it: the PPE register keeps an entry per style.
triage.riskHint: Entered on the PPE register entry; it can be decided there later.

problem.answerDue: Choose the day the answer is due.
problem.answerDueBefore: The answer is due on or after the day the complaint came in.
problem.style: A safety complaint needs the garment's style for the PPE register.

safety.title: Safety complaint {number}: confirm
safety.lead: This is about safety: the garment may not protect (Reg. (EU) 2016/425 art. 8(4)). Saving does all of this now:
safety.toldNobody: nobody else holds the right to be told at this company – tell the owner yourself.
safety.register: A PPE register entry opens for {style} ({risk}), linked to this complaint.
safety.closes: The complaint closes only after the owner acknowledges the alert; the banner stays until then.
safety.notSent: Nothing is sent to the customer or an authority: the notice to the authority is a duty of the register entry.
safety.noHold: No stock is put on hold by this step: raise an NCR to hold the batch's stock still here.

photos.label: Photos of the complaint ({count})
photos.open: Open photo {n} in a new tab
photos.addInActivity: More photos and the customer's mail go on the record's thread (Activity).

log.title: Log complaint
log.customerScan: Scan a serial to find the customer
log.customerNoRight: Your role cannot list customers: scan the garment's serial to find its customer.
log.serialHint: Scan or type the serial on the label: our serial finds its style, batch, shipment and customer.
log.lookUpHeld: Scan a serial or choose the customer first
log.garmentOther: Our garment, made for another customer
log.others_one: This customer has {count} other open complaint: is it the same?
log.others_other: This customer has {count} other open complaints: is it one of them?
log.words: What happened, in the customer's words
log.wordsHint: Write it as the customer said it; quality triages it.
log.photosHint: Up to {max} images; sent once the complaint is logged.
log.noteHint: For the office only: never shown to the customer.

problem.customer: Choose the customer (or scan the serial).
problem.words: Write what happened, in the customer's words.
problem.future: The complaint came in today or earlier.
problem.photoKind: Photos only (JPG, PNG, WebP or HEIC), at most 15 MB each.

record.evidence: Evidence trail of the garment (new tab)
record.safetyRaised: Safety alert raised {time}: the owner has not acknowledged it yet.
record.safetyRaisedBody: The owner and quality were told. The complaint closes only after the acknowledgement.
record.closed: Closed on {day}: it no longer changes.
record.valueNoGrain: Your role does not see prices
record.notTriaged: Not triaged yet: quality gives it a category, a severity, an owner and the answer's due day.
record.registerNoRight: Your role does not see the PPE register.
record.editWordsRequired: The customer's words stay on the complaint

linked.ncrNoRight: Your role does not see NCRs.
linked.repairsNoRight: Your role does not see repairs.

move.investigateBody: Quality looks into it (the returned garment, the batch, the evidence trail).
move.answeredBody: The customer was answered another way (by phone or in person).
move.answeredNoteHint: How and what was answered, kept in the record's history.
move.reopenLetter: The letter sent (version {version}) stays kept; the letter can be changed and sent again.
move.answeredLetter: To answer with a letter, write it on the Answer tab and send it from there: it marks the complaint answered.

closeDialog.title: Close {number}
closeDialog.body: A closed complaint never changes again. A safety complaint closes once the owner acknowledged it and it is in the PPE register.
closeDialog.reasonHint: Answered and accepted, a duplicate of another complaint, logged by mistake…

registerDialog.title: Add {number} to the PPE register
registerDialog.body: Opens a PPE register entry of kind Complaint for {style}, linked to this complaint (Reg. (EU) 2016/425 art. 8(4)).
registerDialog.riskHint: The risk as assessed now; it is decided on the entry.

ncrDialog.title: Create an NCR from {number}
ncrDialog.body: Raises a nonconformance with the complaint's words, garment, shipment and return; quality follows it up in Nonconformances.
ncrDialog.siteFromShipment: The shipment's site, unless you choose another.
ncrDialog.siteHint: The site that follows the NCR up.

repairDialog.title: Make a repair from {number}
repairDialog.body: Makes a repair order for the customer's garment with the complaint's words; it waits for the garment unless it is here.
repairDialog.siteHint: The site that repairs it (default: the company's plant).
repairDialog.received: The garment is here already (it came with the customer)

dialog.siteNoList: Your role cannot list the sites: the default is used.

held.offline: Offline: changes wait until the connection is back
held.noneNew: None of the selected complaints is new
held.noEvidence: No serial or batch named: there is no evidence trail to open
held.CLOSED: The complaint is closed: it no longer changes
held.NOT_TRIAGED: It is new: triage it first
held.SAFETY_NOT_ACKNOWLEDGED: A safety complaint closes only after the owner acknowledges the alert
held.NOT_IN_REGISTER: A safety complaint closes only once it is in the PPE register
held.IN_REGISTER: It is in the PPE register already
held.NO_STYLE: Name the garment's style first: the PPE register keeps an entry per style

NO_PERMISSION.edit: Your role cannot change complaints (quality.complaints.log while new, quality.complaints.manage after)
NO_PERMISSION.acknowledge: Only the owner acknowledges a safety alert (quality.complaints.acknowledge)
NO_PERMISSION.register: Adding to the PPE register needs quality.complaints.manage and compliance.register.manage

held.ANSWER_SENT: The letter went out and the complaint is answered: back to investigating to change it
held.NO_ANSWER: Write the letter first (its words, in Italian or English)

refusal.conflict: Someone changed this complaint in the meantime. It has been read again: check and try once more.
refusal.invalid: It was refused as it is: check the fields.

field.styleId: The style was refused: choose a style of the tenant.
field.answerDueOn: The answer's due day was refused: on or after the day the complaint came in.
field.ownerId: That person cannot follow complaints up here: choose another owner.
field.description: The customer's words were refused: write what happened.
field.receivedAt: The day it came in was refused: today or earlier.
field.partyId: That customer was refused: choose an active customer of the company.
field.shipmentId: That shipment is not of this customer and company.
field.salesOrderId: That order is not of this customer and company.
field.returnId: That return is not of this customer and company.
field.siteId: Choose an active site of the company.
field.serial: The serial was refused: check it.
field.findings: The findings were refused: at most 4000 characters, from triage on.
field.rootCause: The root cause was refused: at most 2000 characters, from triage on.
field.template: The template was refused: choose one of the list.
field.language: The language was refused: Italian or English.
field.text: The letter's words were refused: at most 8000 characters.
field.fileIds: A file was refused: only available files of this complaint go with the letter.
field.contactIds: A recipient was refused: choose active contacts of the customer with an e-mail.
field.cc: A copy address was refused: check the e-mail addresses.
field.subject: The subject was refused: at most 200 characters.
field.attachments: A file was refused: share it with the customer first.

notice.readFailed: The page could not be read again: it shows its last copy.

done.photosFailed_one: {count} photo could not be sent: add it on the record's thread.
done.photosFailed_other: {count} photos could not be sent: add them on the record's thread.
done.safetyRaised: {number}: the owner and quality were told; PPE register entry {reference} opened.
done.answerSent: {number} answered: letter version {version} sent to the customer.

links.intro: Link the complaint's order, shipment, return or garment, or an NCR; unlink what does not belong.
links.closed: A closed complaint never changes: its links stay as they are.
links.title: Link a record to {number}
links.body: Pick what the complaint is about. The order, shipment, return and garment are the complaint's own facts (one each); an NCR is linked on its side and names this complaint.
links.serialHint: Scan the garment's label or type its serial: the garment is looked up when you link it.
links.namedAlready: Linked now: {label}. Unlink it first to link another one.

typeHint.ReturnAuthorisation: The return the garment came back with.
typeHint.GarmentSerial: Our garment, by the serial on its label.
typeHint.Nonconformance: An open NCR of the company that investigates this complaint.

pickHint.Nonconformance: Open NCRs of the company not linked yet, newest first.

noneToPick.SalesOrder: This customer has no order to pick.
noneToPick.Shipment: This customer has no shipment to pick.
noneToPick.ReturnAuthorisation: This customer has no return to pick.
noneToPick.Nonconformance: No open NCR of the company is left to link.

unlinkBody.SalesOrder: Order {label} is no longer what {number} is about. You can link it again later.
unlinkBody.Shipment: Shipment {label} is no longer what {number} is about. You can link it again later.
unlinkBody.ReturnAuthorisation: Return {label} is no longer linked to {number}. You can link it again later.
unlinkBody.GarmentSerial: The serial {label} is taken off {number}: the garment's facts and its evidence trail go with it.
unlinkBody.Nonconformance: {label} no longer names {number}. The NCR itself stays as it is.

held.log: Linking records to a new complaint needs quality.complaints.log.
held.manage: Once triaged, a complaint's links are changed by quality (quality.complaints.manage).
held.orders: Your role does not see orders (orders.view).
held.shipments: Your role does not see shipments (shipping.view).
held.returns: Your role does not see returns (sales.returns.view).
held.garment: Finding a garment by its serial needs quality.inspections.view or production.serials: type the serial in the complaint's facts instead.
held.ncrView: Your role does not see NCRs (quality.ncr.view).
held.ncrRaise: Linking an NCR needs quality.ncr.raise at its site.
held.ncrManage: Unlinking an NCR needs quality.ncr.manage at its site.
held.source: This NCR was raised from this complaint: it stays linked.

problem.taken: The complaint names {label} already: unlink it first.
problem.serial: Scan or type the garment's serial first.
problem.record: Pick the record to link first.
problem.ncr: Pick the NCR to link first.
problem.ncrLinked: This NCR names the complaint already.

refused.taken: The complaint is linked to another one of these already: unlink it first.
refused.ncrTaken: This NCR names the complaint already, or links all it may.
refused.source: This NCR was raised from this complaint: it stays linked.
refused.gone: It is no longer linked: the complaint was read again.
refused.garment: No garment of ours has this serial: check the label, or keep the serial as reported in the complaint's facts.
refused.notFound: This record is no longer there, or is not this customer's: pick another one.

mail.intoThread: Mail from the customer's contacts with {number} in its subject lands on this thread by itself.

capa.elsewhere: Escalated to a corrective action your role does not see.
capa.none: Not escalated to a corrective action: an NCR raised from it is escalated from the NCR.
capa.noRight: Your role does not see corrective actions.

investigation.title: Investigation
investigation.sub: What the investigation found and why it happened.
investigation.findingsHint: What was found on the garment, the batch, the evidence trail.
investigation.rootCauseHint: Why it happened, in a few words.
investigation.officeOnly: For the office only: never printed and never sent to the customer (the answer letter says what the customer reads).
investigation.linksSub: The returned garment, the nonconformances and the corrective action.
investigation.returnHint: The returned garment is inspected on the return.

held.findingsLong: The findings are too long (at most 4000 characters)
held.rootCauseLong: The root cause is too long (at most 2000 characters)

answer.sent: Answered by letter on {time} by {who} ({via}, version {version}).
answer.sentBody: The letter is frozen while the complaint stays answered: back to investigating to change it. Every version stays.
answer.answeredOtherWay: Answered without a letter (by phone or in person): the letter changes once the complaint goes back to investigating.
answer.title: Answer to the customer
answer.sub: A letter from a template, in the customer's language. Nothing is sent until you review it and press Send.
answer.templateHint: Its words fill the letter; you change them before sending.
answer.keptWords: Your own words stay in the letter.
answer.textHint: What the customer reads, as it will be printed.
answer.filesHint: Files of this complaint (add them on the Activity tab). Only a file shared with the customer goes with the mail.
answer.filesNoRight: Your role does not see files (files.read).
answer.filesNone: This complaint has no file yet: add one on the Activity tab.

held.textLong: The letter is too long (at most 8000 characters)
held.files: At most 10 files go with a letter
held.saveFirst: Save the letter first: Send sends the letter as saved

preview.title: As the customer gets it
preview.sub: The letter as saved, with the preview banner: nothing is kept or sent.
preview.none: Write and save the letter to see it here.
preview.idle: The preview shows once the letter is read.
preview.letterhead: The letter cannot be made: the company's letterhead is incomplete (legal name, address, VAT number, codice fiscale, REA). Complete it in Admin › Companies & sites.

versions.title: Versions kept ({count})
versions.sub: Each letter sent is kept as a version.

send.title: Send the answer of {number}
send.body: The letter of {number} goes as a PDF in {language}, with the files shared with the customer. Check who gets it.
send.heldTooMany: At most 10 people get one letter
send.heldCc: A copy address is not an e-mail address
send.heldSubject: The subject is too long (at most 200 characters)
send.toHint: The customer's contacts with an e-mail.
send.subject: Subject
send.messageHint: The mail's own words; the letter goes as the PDF.
send.never: Nothing is sent until you press Send to the customer. It leaves through the company's e-mail.

problem.contactIds: The customer has no active contact with an e-mail: add one to the customer first.
problem.letterhead: The company's letterhead is incomplete (legal name, address, VAT number, codice fiscale, REA): complete it in Admin › Companies & sites.
problem.notShared: A file with the letter is not shared with the customer: share it, or untick it.
problem.filesRead: A letter goes with files only for a sender who may read files (files.read).
problem.other: The letter cannot go as it stands: check the letter and the customer.
